mechanism: Pad+detrend series, FFT, multiply DFT bins by Gaussian-shaped lowpass (wt=1 for f≤freq else exp(-((f-freq)/width)^2)), inverse FFT (+optional retrend). Output tracks slow local mean/tendency of the process—low center freq → smoother regime level.
data_needed: Price or other 1-D series; center freq and width in cycles/sample (freq∈[0,0.5], width≳0.01); padding and detrend flags.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic financial time series; AFD demo on random/synthetic series; any TF via samples/cycle
why_new_for_mis: Frequency-domain Gaussian lowpass gives MIS a controllable slow-tendency regime level orthogonal to time-domain MAs, with explicit freq/width knobs in cycles per sample.
quote: A lowpass filter emphasizes low frequencies in a signal. Mostly used to detect the general tendency of a process.

mechanism: Same DFT pipeline with highpass: attenuate bins below the center-frequency passband, pass higher bands. Removes slow drift so filtered series highlights rapid changes—complement to lowpass regime level.
data_needed: Same as lowpass: series + freq/width in cycles/sample; pad/detrend.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic financial TS; AFD random-series demos
why_new_for_mis: Highpass-in-frequency isolates fast residual motion as a change feature bank MIS can pair with the lowpass tendency sensor.
quote: A highpass filter removes all slow variation from the signal leaving only information about rapid changes.

mechanism: Apply 90°-shifted (pure-imaginary) Gaussian bandpass in the frequency domain. Peaks/troughs of the in-quadrature output align with zero-crossings of the in-phase bandpass and fire on sharp level jumps that in-phase filters miss—explicit rapid-level-change detector.
data_needed: Series + matched freq/width for in-phase and in-quadrature bandpass; complex inverse FFT path (via Qmf or separate IQ filter).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Illustrated on brief periodic and explosive level-change synthetic series; intended for financial TS
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a phase-shifted bandpass shock sensor for abrupt regime/level breaks that ordinary in-phase filters smear.
quote: While it is difficult to ascertain the move using the in-phase output, the in-quadrature filtered series detects the explosive move.

mechanism: Quadrature-mirror pair: treat in-phase as real and in-quadrature as imag; amplitude=sqrt(re^2+im^2), phase=atan2(im,re). Amplitude peaks mark presence/strength of a localized periodic component at the chosen passband; sample multiple (freq,width) with width∝freq and time-extent≈0.8/width.
data_needed: Series; one or more (center freq, width) pairs; complex Qmf output; respect wrap-around lag ≈0.8/width before live use.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AFD demos at freq 0.15/0.3/0.45 width 0.03 on random series; any market series/TF

mechanism: OLS lag-augmented Δy regression; ADF statistic = t-stat of lagged level coeff; MacKinnon p-value and critical values. Reject unit root → stationary sample; fail to reject → trending/persistent non-stationary regime. Used to judge transforms inducing stationarity.

mechanism: Regress y1 on y2 (+trend); ADF(TREND_NONE) on residuals. If residual ADF rejects unit root, pair is cointegrated—long-run equilibrium link usable for pairs/stat-arb sensing. Script grids symbol pairs (CopyClose) and flags likely cointegrated at chosen confidence.
